label: cbstats
type: the per-node CLI statistics tool, reached over the KV port, used for stats the Web Console does not surface - collection change-history status (`collections-details`), vBucket details, and the clock-drift counters that timestamp-based conflict resolution depends on.
evidence: The change-history status of each collection can be returned by means of the `cbstats` tool, with the arguments `collections-details`.
Drift can be monitored by means of the [cbstats](#cli:cbstats/cbstats-intro.adoc) tool
On the command-line, statistics can be managed with the [cbstats](../../cli/cbstats-intro.md) tool.
note: Joins the promoted CLI-tool family (cbbackupmgr, cbcollect-info, cbexport, cbimport, cbq-shell, cbsqlitedump). Its second evidence quote carries an unresolved Antora cross-reference - `#cli:cbstats/cbstats-intro.adoc` leaked into the Markdown snapshot as literal link text - which is one of two such leaks round 26 found and filed as docs-issues.
